summary: This US Holocaust Memorial Museum encyclopedia article describes the Axis powers of World War II, centered on Germany, Italy, and Japan, and how their alliance was formed through treaties and pacts in the late 1930s and 1940. It explains how Germany pressured European states such as Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Yugoslavia and Croatia to join, and how each of Germany's European allies participated in the Holocaust. It also covers the disintegration of the Axis from 1943 onward, ending with Japan's surrender on September 2, 1945.
one_line: Overview of the Axis powers in World War II, their formation through pacts, the European states that joined, and their collapse by 1945.
key_facts: The three principal partners in the Axis alliance were Germany, Italy, and Japan.
The Axis powers were opposed by the Allied Powers, led by Great Britain, the United States, and the Soviet Union.
Five other countries that joined the Tripartite Pact and became Axis powers were Bulgaria, Croatia, Hungary, Romania, and Slovakia.
Each of Germany's six European Axis allies participated in the Holocaust by murdering Jews or by transferring them to German custody to be murdered.
Germany and Italy signed a treaty of friendship on October 25, 1936, which became known as the Rome-Berlin Axis.
Germany, Italy, and Japan signed the Tripartite Pact on September 27, 1940.
Germany and Italy signed the Pact of Friendship and Alliance on May 22, 1939, which Mussolini dubbed the Pact of Steel.
Japan invaded the rest of China on July 7, 1937, initiating the war in the Pacific.
Hungary joined the Axis alliance on November 20, 1940; Romania joined on November 23, 1940; Slovakia joined on November 24, 1940.
Bulgaria joined the Axis on March 1, 1941, and Yugoslavia reluctantly joined on March 25, 1941, before being overthrown and invaded by the Axis.
Italy surrendered to the Allies on September 8, 1943, after Mussolini was deposed and arrested in late July 1943.
Romania switched sides on August 23, 1944, following the overthrow of dictator Marshal Ion Antonescu.
Hitler committed suicide on April 30, 1945, and Nazi Germany surrendered unconditionally to the Allies on May 8–9, 1945.
Japan formally surrendered on September 2, 1945, after fighting alone during the summer of 1945 following the defeat of its Axis allies.

entities.name: Germany
entities.role: Principal Axis partner that pressured other European states to join the Axis and began prewar expansion in 1938

entities.name: Italy
entities.role: Principal Axis partner that invaded Ethiopia (Abyssinia) on October 3, 1935, and surrendered to the Allies on September 8, 1943

entities.name: Japan
entities.role: Principal Axis partner that seized Manchuria in 1931, invaded China in 1937, and attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941

entities.name: Adolf Hitler
entities.role: German dictator who led Nazi Germany and decided in July 1940 to attack the Soviet Union

entities.name: Benito Mussolini
entities.role: Italian dictator who was deposed and arrested in July 1943 and dubbed the Germany-Italy military alliance the Pact of Steel

entities.name: Hirohito
entities.role: Japanese Emperor who led Japan in the Axis alliance

entities.name: Winston Churchill
entities.role: British Prime Minister who led Great Britain among the Allied Powers

entities.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
entities.role: US President who led the United States among the Allied Powers

entities.name: Joseph Stalin
entities.role: Soviet Premier who led the Soviet Union among the Allied Powers

entities.name: Ion Antonescu
entities.role: Romanian marshal and dictator whose overthrow in 1944 led Romania to switch sides

entities.name: Tripartite Pact
entities.role: September 27, 1940 pact formalizing the alliance of Germany, Italy, and Japan as the Axis powers

entities.name: Anti-Comintern Pact
entities.role: Pact signed November 25, 1936 by Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan, directed at the Soviet Union

entities.name: Pact of Steel
entities.role: Pact of Friendship and Alliance signed May 22, 1939 by Germany and Italy, providing for military cooperation

entities.name: Rome-Berlin Axis
entities.role: Treaty of friendship between Germany and Italy signed October 25, 1936

entities.name: Declaration by United Nations
entities.role: Declaration signed January 1, 1942, by which the Allied powers formally allied

entities.name: Independent State of Croatia
entities.role: Satellite state created by the Axis powers in the dismemberment of Yugoslavia, run by the fascist Ustaša movement, which joined the Axis June 15, 1941

entities.name: Italian Social Republic
entities.role: State established by Mussolini after German forces freed him, based in Salò and dependent on Germany

entities.name: Pearl Harbor
entities.role: Site of the Japanese surprise attack on the United States on December 7, 1941

entities.name: Winter War
entities.role: 1939–1940 war between Finland and the Soviet Union, whose lost territory Finland sought to regain in 1941

entities.name: Ustaša movement
entities.role: Fascist movement whose Croat members ran the Independent State of Croatia
